releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v8.13.9 - Civilized Acoustics & Ultra-Low CPU Overhaul:
- Replaced aggressive fan revving with smooth, progressive, whisper-quiet curve (20% PWM / ~1,500 RPM whisper floor below 50°C).
- Fixed fan stop-and-rev bug in dispatch loop.
- Optimized UI animation timer to 50ms for near 0.0% background CPU consumption.
- Forced 2D desktop apps to iGPU so RTX 4060 dGPU achieves 0.0W D3Cold sleep on idle.
